[[Toma]] is a drake with a ferocious appetite. He once was owned by the [[Kourna]]ns in the nearby garrison on [[Marga Coast]], but then got away and began harassing villagers in [[Ronjok]].

After capturing [[Ferocious Drake|the beast]] in [[Drake in a Cage]], [[Koss]] decides instead to tame him and have him defend the village. He must be fed in the quests [[Feeding Frenzy]] and [[Insatiable Appetite]] so he doesn't decide to eat the villagers.
